# 4.2 Loading Function

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

load_and_inspect <- function(file_path) {
  data <- read_csv(file_path)
  cat("--- Data Loaded Successfully ---\n")
  cat("File:", file_path, "\n\n")
  cat("---- Glimpse of Data ----\n")
  print(glimpse(data))
  cat("\n---- First Rows ----\n")
  print(head(data))
  return(data)
}

my_data <- load_and_inspect("solar_system_planets.csv")
```

# 4.3 Query Function

```{r}
filter_planets_by_type <- function(data, planet_type_name) {
  result <- data |> dplyr::filter(type == planet_type_name)
  return(result)
}

gas_giants <- filter_planets_by_type(my_data, "Gas Giant")
gas_giants
```

# 4.4 Reporting Function

```{r}
generate_report <- function(data, planet_name) {
  planet_data <- data |> dplyr::filter(name == planet_name)

  record_count <- nrow(planet_data)
  avg_mass <- mean(planet_data$mass, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_radius <- max(planet_data$radius, na.rm = TRUE)
  avg_distance <- mean(planet_data$distance_from_sun, na.rm = TRUE)
  avg_gravity <- mean(planet_data$gravity, na.rm = TRUE)

  cat("--- Report for:", planet_name, "---\n")
  cat("Records found:", record_count, "\n")
  cat("Average mass:", round(avg_mass, 2), "\n")
  cat("Max radius:", max_radius, "\n")
  cat("Average distance from Sun:", round(avg_distance, 2), "\n")
  cat("Average gravity:", round(avg_gravity, 2), "\n")
  cat("----------------------------------\n\n")
}

generate_report(my_data, "Earth")
generate_report(my_data, "Jupiter")
```
